SCRIPT-COMPILER skill build Config: …

Pure-text meta-compiler for scripts. Takes one or more reference texts (monologue, video-essay narration, sermon, ad copy, explainer, any prose written to move a listener) and builds the slot-grammar script engine that regenerates the same construction on any new subject. Works entirely in the model's own text generation, with no code, scripts or external tools: numbers every sentence, hand-counts length and rhythm in a visible table, maps semantic beats, extracts the modal ladder and register rules by pattern-matching, maps each slot's truth profile so a FIDELITY dial can govern what is allowed to be true, and emits a self-contained, paste-ready engine prompt with scope guard, distress exit and trace. The structured successor to script-dna's qualitative extraction. Invoke with /script-compiler, "compile this script", "build the script engine for this", "slot grammar from this text", "engine from this reference".
